notes.title: July development update!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]Here's a quick update on how things are going!![/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Core Game[/h3][list][*][p]New amp enemy + polishing existing dream levels[/p][/*][*][p]Guitar assembly mini-game + new guitar luthier/factory location[/p][/*][*][p]New customization options for guitars (string colors, designer/painter tweaks)[/p][/*][/list][h3]👥 Multiplayer[/h3][list][*][p]Enemy AI for scorpion monster working in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Guitar switching & transferring between players online[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🎮 Where is the Demo?[/h3][p]For those wondering, the demo has been removed from the store for now.
A lot of new features have been added recently, and the [b]old demo's save file became incompatible[/b] with the current full game build.[/p][p]To avoid confusion - especially around save data carry over to full game - I've deactivated the demo. [/p][p]Also, online data submitted from the old demo could potentially conflict with the current online backend.[/p][p]If you still have the demo installed, you'll notice that it can't be launched anymore. That is normal.[/p][h3]🖥️ Will the demo come back?[/h3][p]Possibly - I might bring it back closer to launch, especially for players who want to test performance on their system. Stay tuned![/p][h3]💚 Already played the demo?[/h3][p]If you tried the demo and liked what you played, please consider wishlisting the game and spreading the word on social media. [/p][p]It really means a lot - thank you![/p][p][/p][h3]🌐 Multiplayer Test Coming... Soon?[/h3][p]I'm planning a [b]limited network test[/b], possibly in a few weeks (depending on how development goes).[/p][p]This will be a limited-time demo for [url="https://discord.gg/HeEt57KWgq"]Discord[/url] members only, to gather feedback and bug reports.[/p][p]It'll be slightly different from the old demo, with a shortcut to jump straight into multiplayer. [/p][p]Maybe everyone gets $5,000 in-game to quickly buy and test custom guitars in multiplayer?[/p][p][/p][h3]📆 Release Timeline...?[/h3][p]There is no firm release date yet.[/p][p]Optimistically, I'd love to finish development by the end of the year. But it could slip into early next year.[/p][p]Some parts of the game take longer than others, and I'm still figuring out how to best spend development time.[/p][p][/p][h3]📣Stay Connected[/h3][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Feel free to follow development and reach out to me on any of these platforms:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/doublewhammy_sg/"]Instagram[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@doublewhammy_sg"]TikTok[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/HeEt57KWgq"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/DoubleWhammy_sg"]X (Twitter)[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/doublewhammy.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.threads.com/@doublewhammy_sg"]Threads[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UConr6vBQvX0UfmXvRTyPX7w"]YouTube[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎬 Check out short clips of new features in action below ⬇️[/h3][previewyoutube="wwkCMcqEYw0;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="dIvbMaFbz1E;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="F7HOoSzDjoI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hrLFV45Lhgg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: May Development Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Development on [i]Double Whammy[/i] is going smoothly, and I've got some exciting updates to share.

[b]New Gameplay Montage:[/b]
[previewyoutube=hlvNHah4Rgo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Recent Developments[/b]:
[list]
[*]New guitar designer features - flexible string count (up to 200 strings...!), more intuitive shaping mode, new parts
[*]New dream levels - drum-poline & high-speed bass chase
[*]Prototype Online Multiplayer
[*]Guitar Freeplay
[/list]
📽️ Check out the videos below
[previewyoutube=i066qiQyS3w;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=kcW8OlcyQow;full][/previewyoutube]
Running on 2 computers connected through the internet!

[previewyoutube=x9f9m2Lju28;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=ka5YkIiU3GM;full][/previewyoutube]

For online multiplayer, I'm working on three modes:
[list]
[*]1v1 combat
[*]Guitar grind race
[*]2 player co-op survival against monster hordes
[/list]
Implementing multiplayer is a huge undertaking, so I can't promise it'll be ready by launch - but I'll do my best!

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Happy New Year! Alpha demo testing begins!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E7w0J2-ItRY;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone, happy new year!

I've opened up the game to players on Discord for alpha demo testing!

Currently you can do these things in the game:
[list]
[*]Fight monsters with guitars in the dream realm
[*]Play guitars in the rhythm game
[*]Make custom guitars
[*]Sell guitars at the guitar shop
[/list]
Feel free to come to the [url=https://discord.gg/FaYPxtfFX4 ]Double Whammy Discord server[/url] to check out the game and share your feedback!

[url=https://discord.gg/FaYPxtfFX4 ]https://discord.gg/FaYPxtfFX4 [/url]
